newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI moves to wind up CRB Capital.
newsitem.headline: India RBI moves to wind up CRB Capital.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Wednesday it has filed a petition to wind up troubled finance firm CRB Capital Markets Ltd.
"The RBI has filed a wind-up petition against CRB Capital Markets," the central bank said in a statement.
The move came after firm chairman C.R. Bhansali failed to meet central bank officials to explain discrepancies in the company's operations and how he planned to repay depositors.
CRB Capital Markets has been accused by investors of defaulting on the repayment of fixed deposits and loans from banks. Initial estimates run into billions of rupees, Indian newspapers said.
Major Indian stock exchanges have suspended trade in shares of CRB group companies, officials said.
